messages:
Aisha: Heads up — we have 3 art crates arriving tomorrow 10:30 for the investor reception. Courier note: "oversize crate 1 of 3". Can front desk stage them in the north lobby loading area? Also two visitors (L. Chen, K. Patel) need day badges + wheelchair access.
FrontDeskBot: Shipment scanned: CRATE-7823 / CRATE-7824 / CRATE-7825. Will hold in loading bay. Please confirm point of contact for release.
Tom: I can meet the courier at 10:30 and bring a dolly + two helpers. FYI one crate marked "fragile — glass".
Riley: Can we reserve the small meeting pod by north lobby for artist prep? They'll need a 6ft table for uncrating and photo staging.
Marta: Pod reserved 10:15–12:00. Badges for L. Chen and K. Patel are prepped as temporary visitor badges. Do they need parking?
Aisha: Yes please — parking for 1 car. Use code `PARK-47`. Also one guest is vegan; catering will bring a small box that needs refrigeration on arrival.
Sam: Quick q — where do we store crates overnight? Not ideal to leave in main lobby. I nominate Conf Room 2 (ground floor) behind the curtain. Need facilities ok.
Tom: Conf 2 works. I'll bring ratchet straps and label the crates. One of us should post a sign: "Do not enter — art in progress".
Marta: For now please use the "special-shipments" shelf in loading bay. I'll coordinate with facilities to move to Conf 2 after unboxing. Sign and parking pass handled. :white_check_mark:
Riley: Also heads up — K. Patel prefers a quiet space to prep before the meeting. Hotdesk 42 (near plants) is usually free; I can move my stuff there.
Aisha: Thanks. FrontDeskBot, can you ping facilities at 9:45 tomorrow and request a temporary badge with red stripe labeled "Artist"?
FrontDeskBot: Facilities ticket created FAC-9012. Temporary badges will be printed at 10:00. Parking code `PARK-47` delivered to Aisha via DM.
Marta: Can someone please take a quick photo of the crate labels after delivery? We need photos for insurance + inventory.
Tom: On it — will snap labels and upload to #art-logistics right after delivery.
Sam: If anybody wants to help unbox after the courier leaves, I can stay till 12:30.
Aisha: Appreciate it — see you all tomorrow.
